title: GitHub - choiyounggi/cliclaw: A Telegram bot that drives four local coding CLIs — Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and Gemini — from your phone. macOS daemon with per-chat per-agent sessions, a confirm gate for dangerous commands, response streaming, image attachments, auto-installed launchd, and corporate-TLS (Zscaler) auto-detection.

content_html:
English | 한국어

A single daemon that lets you drive four local coding CLIs (Claude Code · Codex · Pi · Gemini) from Telegram, switching between them per chat.

It keeps an independent per-agent session for every chat, and ships a confirm gate for dangerous commands, response streaming, image-attachment handling, and auto-detection of corporate TLS interceptors (Zscaler, etc.).

Install only the CLIs you want — missing agents are automatically dropped from the active list.

The chat UX (user messages, errors, /help) is currently Korean-first; the bot itself works fine either way.

Quick start (3 minutes)

1. Prerequisites

  • macOS (Apple Silicon / Intel)
  • Bun 1.x — curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
  • At least one of the coding CLIs installed and logged in (the bot merely spawns authenticated child processes)
    • Claude Code: npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code
    • Codex: npm install -g @openai/codex
    • Pi: npm install -g @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent
    • Gemini: npm install -g @google/gemini-cli

2. Install

# Bun (recommended)
bun add -g @younggichoi/cliclaw

# or npm
npm install -g @younggichoi/cliclaw

The package publishes under a scoped name (@younggichoi/cliclaw), but the installed command is simply cliclaw.

3. Interactive setup

cliclaw init

Five steps, guided:

Welcome to cliclaw setup.

Step 1/5 — Telegram bot token
  Get one from @BotFather (/newbot) on Telegram.
  Bot token: 1234:ABC...
  ✓ @yourbotname (id=...) verified

Step 2/5 — Detect installed coding agents
  ✓ claude  2.1.139 (Claude Code)         @ ~/.nvm/.../bin/claude
  ✓ codex   1.0.0                          @ /opt/homebrew/bin/codex
  ✓ pi      unknown                        @ /opt/homebrew/bin/pi
  ✓ gemini  0.42.0                         @ ~/.nvm/.../bin/gemini
  Default agent? [claude] (claude/codex/pi/gemini): claude

Step 3/5 — Authorize your Telegram account
  Open Telegram and send any message to @yourbotname now.
  Waiting up to 5 minutes... press Ctrl-C to abort.
  ✓ Received from user_id=123456789
  Authorize this Telegram user? [Y/n] y

Step 4/5 — Corporate TLS interceptor (optional)
  $NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS: /path/to/Zscaler.pem
  Apply this CA certificate to the bot's LaunchAgent environment? [Y/n] y

Step 5/5 — Auto-start at login (launchd)
  Install LaunchAgent so the bot starts automatically on login? [Y/n] y
  ✓ Installed ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.alice.cliclaw.plist
  ✓ Bot started.

All set.
  Logs:  tail -f ~/.cliclaw/logs/bot.log
  Test:  send /status in Telegram.

That's it. The bot restarts automatically after screen lock or a reboot.

CLI commands

Command What it does
cliclaw init Interactive setup (token, agent detection, telegram-id capture, CA, launchd)
cliclaw start Run the bot in the foreground (for testing)
cliclaw install-launchd Install the LaunchAgent (auto-applies launchd.extraEnv from config.json)
cliclaw uninstall-launchd Remove the LaunchAgent
cliclaw doctor Check paths, agents, and plist status
cliclaw help Help

Chat commands (in Telegram)

Command What it does
/claude /codex /pi /gemini Switch this chat's active agent (uninstalled agents are hidden)
/status Per-agent session status + any job in progress
/health Bot system status (uptime, memory, log sizes, chat/job counts)
/stop Cancel this chat's running job (SIGTERM → SIGKILL after 5s)
/reset Discard only the current active agent's session
/reset all Discard every agent session in this chat
/safety Show safety-mode status — toggle with /safety on / /safety off
/start /help Help
Any other text / photo Sent as a prompt to the active agent (photos are downloaded and their path is prepended to the prompt)

Switching agents keeps the old session intact — come back and continue. Sending a new prompt to a chat with a running job is rejected (use /stop or wait).

Directory layout

All state is isolated under ~/.cliclaw/:

~/.cliclaw/
├── config.json              # mode 600; token, allowlist, launchd extraEnv
├── safety.json              # persisted /safety on|off state
├── sessions.json            # per-chat active-agent metadata
├── sessions/                # per-chat codex / pi / gemini directories
├── workspace/               # the agents' shared cwd (sandbox)
│   ├── .claude/settings.json # dangerous-command hook + deny rules when safety is ON
│   └── uploads/<chatId>/    # Telegram photo downloads
├── logs/
│   ├── bot.log              # token auto-masking applied
│   ├── bot.err              # launchd stderr
│   └── audit.jsonl          # audit log (decisions, safety state)
└── .sock/                   # confirm-gate IPC

The state directory can be moved with the CLICLAW_HOME env var:

CLICLAW_HOME=~/my-bot cliclaw init

Features

1. Automatic agent path discovery

No absolute paths in config.json. At startup, agents are discovered in three passes:

  1. ~/.local/bin, ~/.claude/local, /usr/local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin
  2. bin/<cmd> of the newest node under $NVM_DIR or ~/.nvm
  3. command -v <cmd> in a login shell (PATH with .zshrc loaded)

Undetected agents are gracefully skipped. The bot runs fine with any subset of the four.

2. Safety mode (/safety on · /safety off)

ON (default):

  • Dangerous Bash commands (rm -rf, git push --force, DROP, kubectl delete, AWS delete-*, sudo, curl|sh, ssh prd-*, …) are re-confirmed via a Telegram inline keyboard [✅ Allow] [❌ Deny] — no response means auto-deny.
  • Claude's Read tool denies sensitive files: ~/.ssh/**, ~/.aws/**, ~/.gnupg/**, ~/.netrc, ~/.npmrc, **/.env*, **/*.pem, **/id_rsa*, **/id_ed25519*, ./secrets/**.
  • Add your own regexes via confirmGate.extraPatterns.

OFF: if your environment already has an external guard (pre-bash-guard, EDR, …) and the bot's confirm prompts feel redundant, turn it off with one line in Telegram. Deny rules are disabled together. Every IPC request is still recorded in logs/audit.jsonl as decision: allow, reason: safety_off.

The state persists in $CLICLAW_HOME/safety.json across restarts.

3. Response streaming (Claude)

Consumes text_delta from --include-partial-messages and live-updates via editMessageText, debounced at 1.5s. Past 3800 chars it rolls over to a new message.

4. Image attachments

Telegram photos/image documents are downloaded to workspace/uploads/<chatId>/<msgId>.<ext> and the path is prepended to the prompt.

5. Headless permission policy

  • Claude: runs with --permission-mode bypassPermissions — dangerous Bash is caught by the confirm gate, and sensitive files by safety-mode deny rules.
  • Codex: sandbox=workspace-write by default. Never use danger-full-access.
  • Pi: default mode.
  • Gemini: approvalMode=auto_edit by default (edits auto-approved, destructive commands prompt). More autonomous yolo or more conservative default/plan available.

6. Corporate TLS interceptor auto-detection

Where Zscaler / Forticlient / Cisco Umbrella intercepts HTTPS, Node cannot trust Telegram's certificate and the bot cannot run. Step 4 of cliclaw init auto-detects $NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS or launchctl getenv NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS, asks you, and persists it into launchd.extraEnv in config.json. Every later install-launchd bakes it into the plist automatically.

7. Secret masking in logs

Everything written to logs/bot.log / bot.err is pre-redacted:

  • Telegram bot tokens (\d{8,}:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{30,})
  • npm tokens (npm_…)
  • GitHub PATs (gh[pousr]_…)
  • exact matches of the live config.token

Defends against Time Machine backups, EDR, and shoulder surfing alike.

8. Korean UI

All user-facing messages, errors, and /help are in Korean (English copy PRs welcome).

launchd details

Answering "Yes" at step 5 of cliclaw init:

  1. Creates ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.<username>.cliclaw.plist (corporate CA baked in)
  2. Loads and starts it immediately via launchctl bootstrap gui/$UID <plist>
  3. Auto-restarts on login / boot / crash from then on
  4. stdout → ~/.cliclaw/logs/bot.log, stderr → bot.err

Manual management:

# stop (auto-restarts on next login)
launchctl kill SIGTERM gui/$UID/com.<username>.cliclaw

# fully disable (no auto-restart either)
cliclaw uninstall-launchd

# re-enable (auto-applies launchd.extraEnv from config.json)
cliclaw install-launchd

Security

  • The bot token = a remote shell into every installed agent. If it leaks, /revoke at BotFather immediately.
  • An empty allowedUserIds rejects all messages (fail-closed).
  • Keep config.json at mode 600 (init sets it automatically).
  • Never set confirmGate.enabled: false or switch the codex sandbox to danger-full-access.
  • Opting Gemini's approvalMode into yolo auto-approves every tool — use it with full understanding.
  • When in doubt, /safety on re-activates the deny rules instantly.

Manual setup (without init)

To install without the cliclaw init flow:

git clone https://github.com/choiyounggi/cliclaw.git
cd cliclaw
bun install
mkdir -p ~/.cliclaw
cp config.example.json ~/.cliclaw/config.json
chmod 600 ~/.cliclaw/config.json
# fill token and allowedUserIds in config.json, then
bun run bot.ts

Tests

bun run test

Known limits

  • Dangerous patterns are regex-based — 100% classification is impossible; you own the policy.
  • No body-text streaming for Codex / Pi / Gemini (no structured events, or not integrated).
  • Gemini's dangerous commands rely solely on its own approvalMode (bash-confirm IPC not integrated).
  • The hook holds the IPC while waiting for the user's decision.
  • No voice/file attachments (photos only).
  • Concurrent messages in the same chat are rejected (/stop or wait).
  • macOS only.

Changelog

Per-version changes live on GitHub Releases.

Release automation (maintainer)

Publishing a new version:

# 1) bump the version (auto-creates commit + tag)
npm version patch          # or minor / major

# 2) push commit + tag
git push --follow-tags

Then in the GitHub web UI: "Draft a new release" → pick the tag → Publish release. .github/workflows/publish.yml runs automatically through npm publish --access public. The workflow first verifies the release tag matches the package.json version and fails without publishing on a mismatch.

One-time prerequisite: repo Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → register NPM_TOKEN with an npm token capable of 2FA bypass.

  1. https://www.npmjs.com/settings/younggichoi/tokens/new
  2. Issue a Granular Access Token or a Classic Automation token (with 2FA bypass)
  3. Add the npm_… token as the GitHub Actions secret NPM_TOKEN

Hardening option: switch to npm Trusted Publishing (OIDC) and no token is needed at all.

  1. At https://www.npmjs.com/package/@younggichoi/cliclaw/access, add Trusted Publisher → GitHub Actions (workflow filename: publish.yml)
  2. In .github/workflows/publish.yml, add permissions: id-token: write, remove NODE_AUTH_TOKEN, add the --provenance flag
  3. Delete the old NPM_TOKEN secret

Contributing & security

  • Code contributions: CONTRIBUTING.md
  • Dev flow & directory structure: DEVELOPMENT.md
  • Security policy, threat model, vulnerability reports: SECURITY.md

content_html_zh:
英语 |韩国人

一个守护进程，可让您从 Telegram 驱动四个本地编码 CLI（Claude Code · Codex · Pi · Gemini），并在每次聊天时在它们之间切换。

它为每次聊天保留独立的每个代理会话，并为危险命令、响应流、图像附件处理和公司 TLS 拦截器（Zscaler 等）的自动检测提供确认门。

仅安装您需要的 CLI — 缺少的代理会自动从活动列表中删除。
聊天用户体验（用户消息、错误、/帮助）目前以韩语优先；无论哪种方式，机器人本身都可以正常工作。

快速启动（3 分钟）

1. 先决条件

  • macOS（苹果芯片/英特尔）
  • Bun 1.x —curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install |巴什
  • 至少安装并登录了一个编码 CLI（机器人仅生成经过身份验证的子进程） Claude Code：npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code Codex：npm install -g @openai/codex Pi：npm install -g @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent Gemini：npm install -g @google/gemini-cli

2. 安装

# Bun (recommended)
bun add -g @younggichoi/cliclaw

# or npm
npm install -g @younggichoi/cliclaw
该软件包以范围名称（@younggichoi/cliclaw）发布，但安装的命令只是 cliclaw。

3. 互动设置

cliclaw init

引导的五个步骤：

Welcome to cliclaw setup.

Step 1/5 — Telegram bot token
  Get one from @BotFather (/newbot) on Telegram.
  Bot token: 1234:ABC...
  ✓ @yourbotname (id=...) verified

Step 2/5 — Detect installed coding agents
  ✓ claude  2.1.139 (Claude Code)         @ ~/.nvm/.../bin/claude
  ✓ codex   1.0.0                          @ /opt/homebrew/bin/codex
  ✓ pi      unknown                        @ /opt/homebrew/bin/pi
  ✓ gemini  0.42.0                         @ ~/.nvm/.../bin/gemini
  Default agent? [claude] (claude/codex/pi/gemini): claude

Step 3/5 — Authorize your Telegram account
  Open Telegram and send any message to @yourbotname now.
  Waiting up to 5 minutes... press Ctrl-C to abort.
  ✓ Received from user_id=123456789
  Authorize this Telegram user? [Y/n] y

Step 4/5 — Corporate TLS interceptor (optional)
  $NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS: /path/to/Zscaler.pem
  Apply this CA certificate to the bot's LaunchAgent environment? [Y/n] y

Step 5/5 — Auto-start at login (launchd)
  Install LaunchAgent so the bot starts automatically on login? [Y/n] y
  ✓ Installed ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.alice.cliclaw.plist
  ✓ Bot started.

All set.
  Logs:  tail -f ~/.cliclaw/logs/bot.log
  Test:  send /status in Telegram.

就是这样。 屏幕锁定或重新启动后，机器人会自动重新启动。

CLI 命令

命令 它的作用
夹爪热 交互式设置（令牌、代理检测、电报 ID 捕获、CA、launchd）
夹爪开始 在前台运行机器人（用于测试）
cliclaw 安装启动 安装 LaunchAgent（自动应用 config.json 中的 launchd.extraEnv）
cliclaw卸载-launchd 删除启动代理
克拉克医生 检查路径、代理和 plist 状态
夹爪帮助 Help

聊天命令（在 Telegram 中）

命令 它的作用
/克劳德 /codex /pi /gemini 切换此聊天的活动代理（已卸载的代理被隐藏）
/地位 每个代理会话状态 + 任何正在进行的作业
/健康 机器人系统状态（正常运行时间、内存、日志大小、聊天/作业计数）
/stop 取消此聊天正在运行的作业（SIGTERM → SIGKILL 5 秒后）
/reset 仅丢弃当前活动代理的会话
/重置全部 放弃此聊天中的每个代理会话
/安全 显示安全模式状态 — 使用 /safety on / /safety off 进行切换
/开始/帮助 Help
任何其他文字/照片 作为提示发送给活动代理（下载照片并将其路径添加到提示之前）

切换代理可以保持旧会话不变 - 返回并继续。 向正在运行的作业的聊天发送新提示被拒绝（使用 /stop 或等待）。

目录布局

所有状态都在 ~/.cliclaw/ 下隔离：

~/.cliclaw/
├── config.json              # mode 600; token, allowlist, launchd extraEnv
├── safety.json              # persisted /safety on|off state
├── sessions.json            # per-chat active-agent metadata
├── sessions/                # per-chat codex / pi / gemini directories
├── workspace/               # the agents' shared cwd (sandbox)
│   ├── .claude/settings.json # dangerous-command hook + deny rules when safety is ON
│   └── uploads/<chatId>/    # Telegram photo downloads
├── logs/
│   ├── bot.log              # token auto-masking applied
│   ├── bot.err              # launchd stderr
│   └── audit.jsonl          # audit log (decisions, safety state)
└── .sock/                   # confirm-gate IPC

可以使用 CLICLAW_HOME 环境变量移动状态目录：

CLICLAW_HOME=~/my-bot cliclaw init

特征

1. 自动代理路径发现

config.json 中没有绝对路径。 启动时，代理通过三遍被发现：

  1. 〜/ .local / bin，〜/ .claude / local，/ usr / local / bin，/ opt / homebrew / bin
  2. $NVM_DIR 或 ~/.nvm 下最新节点的 bin/<cmd>
  3. 登录 shell 中的命令 -v <cmd> （已加载 .zshrc 的 PATH）

未检测到的代理会被优雅地跳过。 该机器人可以在这四个中的任何一个子集上正常运行。

2. 安全模式（/安全开启·/安全关闭）

开（默认）：

  • 危险的 Bash 命令（rm -rf、git push --force、DROP、kubectl delete、AWS delete-*、sudo、curl|sh、ssh prd-*、...） 通过 Telegram 内联键盘重新确认 [✅ 允许] [❌ 拒绝] — 没有响应意味着自动拒绝。
  • Claude 的读取工具拒绝敏感文件：~/.ssh/**、~/.aws/**、~/.gnupg/**、~/.netrc、~/.npmrc、**/.env*、**/*.pem、**/id_rsa*、**/id_ed25519*、./secrets/**。
  • 通过confirmGate.extraPatterns 添加您自己的正则表达式。

OFF：如果您的环境已经有外部防护（pre-bash-guard、EDR，...） 而且机器人的确认提示感觉多余，只需在 Telegram 中输入一行即可将其关闭。 拒绝规则一起禁用。 每个IPC请求仍然记录在logs/audit.jsonl中，决策：允许，原因：safety_off。

重新启动后，状态仍保留在 $CLICLAW_HOME/safety.json 中。

3. 响应流（克劳德）

使用 --include-partial-messages 中的 text_delta 并通过 editMessageText 进行实时更新，在 1.5 秒时消除抖动。 超过 3800 个字符将转为新消息。

4. 图片附件

Telegram 照片/图像文档将下载到工作区/uploads/<chatId>/<msgId>.<ext>，并且路径会添加到提示符前面。

5. 无头权限策略

  • Claude：使用 --permission-modebypassPermissions 运行 — 危险的 Bash 被确认门捕获，敏感文件被安全模式拒绝规则捕获。
  • Codex：默认情况下 sandbox=workspace-write。 切勿使用危险完全访问。
  • Pi：默认模式。
  • Gemini：默认情况下approvalMode=auto_edit（编辑自动批准的破坏性命令提示）。 更自主的 yolo 或更保守的默认/计划可用。

6. 企业 TLS 拦截器自动检测

当 Zscaler / Forticlient / Cisco Umbrella 拦截 HTTPS 时，Node 无法信任 Telegram 的证书，机器人也无法运行。 cliclaw init 的第 4 步会自动检测 $NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS 或 launchctl getenv NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS，询问您，并将其保存到 config.json 中的 launchd.extraEnv 中。 以后的每个 install-launchd 都会自动将其烘焙到 plist 中。

7. 日志中的秘密屏蔽

写入logs/bot.log / bot.err的所有内容都经过预先编辑：

  • Telegram 机器人令牌 (\d{8,}:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{30,})
  • npm 令牌（npm_…）
  • GitHub PAT (gh[pousr]_…)
  • 实时 config.token 的精确匹配

防御时间机器备份、EDR 和肩窥等。

8. 韩语用户界面

所有面向用户的消息、错误和/帮助均采用韩语（欢迎英文副本 PR）。

启动详情

在 cliclaw init 的第 5 步回答“是”：

  1. 创建 ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.<username>.cliclaw.plist （企业 CA 内置）
  2. 通过 launchctl bootstrap gui/$UID <plist> 立即加载并启动它
  3. 从那时起登录/启动/崩溃时自动重新启动
  4. 标准输出 → ~/.cliclaw/logs/bot.log，标准错误 → bot.err

手动管理：

# stop (auto-restarts on next login)
launchctl kill SIGTERM gui/$UID/com.<username>.cliclaw

# fully disable (no auto-restart either)
cliclaw uninstall-launchd

# re-enable (auto-applies launchd.extraEnv from config.json)
cliclaw install-launchd

安全

  • 机器人令牌 = 每个已安装代理的远程 shell。 如果泄露，请立即在 BotFather 处 /revoke。
  • 空 allowedUserIds 会拒绝所有消息（失败关闭）。
  • 将 config.json 保持在模式 600（init 自动设置）。
  • 切勿设置confirmGate.enabled: false 或将codex 沙箱切换为危险完全访问。
  • 选择 Gemini 的approvalMode 到 yolo 中会自动批准每个工具——在充分理解的情况下使用它。
  • 当有疑问时，/safety on 会立即重新激活拒绝规则。

手动设置（无需初始化）

要在不使用 clilaw init 流程的情况下进行安装：

git clone https://github.com/choiyounggi/cliclaw.git
cd cliclaw
bun install
mkdir -p ~/.cliclaw
cp config.example.json ~/.cliclaw/config.json
chmod 600 ~/.cliclaw/config.json
# fill token and allowedUserIds in config.json, then
bun run bot.ts

Tests

bun run test

已知限制

  • 危险模式是基于正则表达式的——100% 分类是不可能的；您拥有该保单。
  • Codex / Pi / Gemini 没有正文文本流（没有结构化事件，或未集成）。
  • Gemini 的危险命令完全依赖于它自己的approvalMode（bash-confirm IPC 未集成）。
  • 钩子在等待用户决定的同时持有IPC。
  • 没有语音/文件附件（仅限照片）。
  • 同一聊天中的并发消息被拒绝（/停止或等待）。
  • 仅限 macOS。

变更日志

每个版本的更改都在 GitHub 版本上发布。

发布自动化（维护者）

发布新版本：

# 1) bump the version (auto-creates commit + tag)
npm version patch          # or minor / major

# 2) push commit + tag
git push --follow-tags

然后在 GitHub Web UI 中：“起草新版本”→ 选择标签→ 发布版本。 .github/workflows/publish.yml 通过 npmpublish --access public 自动运行。 该工作流程首先验证发布标签与 package.json 版本是否匹配，如果不匹配则发布失败，但不会失败。

一次性先决条件：存储库设置 → 秘密和变量 → 操作 → 使用能够绕过 2FA 的 npm 令牌注册 NPM_TOKEN。

  1. https://www.npmjs.com/settings/younggichoi/tokens/new
  2. 颁发粒度访问令牌或经典自动化令牌（绕过 2FA）
  3. 添加 npm_... 令牌作为 GitHub Actions 秘密 NPM_TOKEN

强化选项：切换到 npm Trusted Publishing (OIDC)，根本不需要令牌。

  1. 在 https://www.npmjs.com/package/@younggichoi/cliclaw/access 中，添加受信任的发布者 → GitHub 操作（工作流程文件名：publish.yml）
  2. 在 .github/workflows/publish.yml 中，添加权限：id-token: write，删除 NODE_AUTH_TOKEN，添加 --provenance 标志
  3. 删除旧的 NPM_TOKEN 密钥

贡献与安全

  • 代码贡献：CONTRIBUTING.md
  • 开发流程和目录结构：DEVELOPMENT.md
  • 安全策略、威胁模型、漏洞报告：SECURITY.md
